component.name: DeskUnion
component.summary: Mouse and keyboard sharing via LAN

description.p: Share one mouse and keyboard between computers on the same network.
Clearer client and server pages, a Connect button that starts sharing, and the Start/Stop button follows the system accent colour.
Ship the version in the Flatpak metadata so software centers detect updates.
Fix the Windows interface freezing when a connection attempt times out, and add a per-user Windows installer option.
